Explanation:- (a) Zyadatar books me is question ka answer aapko elder ke baad 'to' lagana milega aur yeh concept S.P. questions.q: Change the following sentence into positive degree.
o: Yash is best than Harsh.
Yash is as good as Harsh.
Yash and Harsh both are good.
Yash is not good than Harsh.
questions.s:
Correct answer: Yash is as good as Harsh.

Explanation:

  • The sentence "Yash is not better than Harsh" means both have equal ability or quality.

  • The positive degree to express equality is "Yash is as good as Harsh."

  • Other options:

  • Yash is best than Harsh – incorrect comparative and superlative usage

  • Yash and Harsh both are good – correct in meaning but less direct

  • Yash is not good than Harsh – grammatically incorrect

Correct sentence:
"Yash is as good as Harsh."

questions.q: Don’t worry, there is less time for the train to arrive.
o: Don’t worry
there is less time
No error
for the train to arrive
questions.s:
Explanation:- yahan koi comparison nahi ho rha isliye 'less' ka use nahi hoga. inme se koi bhi word laga sakte hain.

some time (thoda time)

enough time (Paryapt time)

a little time (thoda time)

Note:- yahan 'few' ki jagah 'little' ka use nahi ho sakta kyunki sentence ke shuru me 'don't worry' likha hai jisse pta chal raha hai ki hum aage positive meaning dena chahte hain. 'little' laga dene se meaning ho jayega ki 'na ke barabar time bacha hai'.

questions.q: I prefer apples more than oranges.

With the verb prefer, we do not use “more than.”
“Prefer” itself already shows comparison.
So the correct sentence is: I prefer apples to oranges.

no error

Ans:- (c) replace 'the same' with 'them' 'the same' ka use adjective ke roop me kiya jaata hai par hume yahan pronoun ki zarurat hai jo 'notes' noun ko refer karega and 'to return' infinitive ka object banega.

Eg.   She is the same girl that we met in the restaurant.

questions.q: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.
o: on the ecosystem of wetlands
has a negatively effect
Human activity often
questions.s:
The error is in the segment: "has a negatively effect".

  • The word "negatively" is an adverb, but in this context, it is modifying a noun ("effect").

  • To correctly modify a noun, we need an adjective, not an adverb.

  • So, the correct phrase should be: "a negative effect" (where "negative" is an adjective).

Correct Sentence:
Human activity often has a negative effect on the ecosystem of wetlands.

questions.q: Can you please/pass me that / glittery pen black?
questions.s: Adjectives typically follow a certain order: opinion, size, shape, color, origin, material, purpose. In this case, "glittery" is a type of material/appearance, and "black" is a color. The correct order would be "glittery black pen".

questions.q: Select the most appropriate word from the given options that can substitute the word ‘courage’ and make a meaningful sentence.
questions.s:
Correct answer: courageous

Explanation:

  • The sentence needs an adjective to describe the speaker’s lack of courage.

  • Courageous is the adjective meaning having courage.

  • Other options:

  • Discouraging – means causing loss of confidence, incorrect here.

  • Encourage – is a verb meaning to give support, incorrect here.

  • Discourage – is a verb meaning to dissuade, incorrect here.

Correct sentence:
"I am not courageous enough to take this risk."

questions.q: A good breakfast give very energy needed by you.
